description: Hotels featured on a Booking.com city page (e.g. us / new-york): name, property id, sample nightly price as displayed (in the currency you pick), guest score out of 10, review count, stars, district, coordinates, a featured guest review and the hotel URL. Comes from the page's 'top hotels' and 'most booked' blocks (usually 10-15 hotels). Prices are Booking.com's landing-page samples, not a live date search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. new-york, paris, london, istanbul

country.description: Two-letter country code as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. us, fr, gb, tr

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for prices (default USD)

name: travel_booking_com_hotels
title: Travel Booking Com Hotels
